title: chat
summary: MSUI now matches the current Benilla build-5875 chat packet family: every SMSG_MESSAGECHAT sender shape, retained sender/target GUIDs and chatTag, the exact eight-type $-macro gate with deferred name resolution, BG_SYSTEM faction colors, battleground send bytes, player-not-found/wrong-faction feedback, /played, /random, text-emote send/receive, and the receive-side ignore gate. Ignored speakers are dropped before composition; an ordinary ignored whisper sends the byte-exact raw-GUID CMSG_CHAT_IGNORED response while LANG_ADDON traffic does not. Focused packet, composition, color, macro, suppression and wire-body clinical checks cover the slice.

openItems.text: chatTag trailing byte is read but discarded - no <AFK>/<DND>/<GM> sender prefix behavior
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: ChatPackets retains chatTag and ChatFrameLaw composes the exact <AFK>/<DND>/<GM> prefix before the visible player name.

openItems.text: target_guid (the monster shapes' macro subject) is discarded and no $-macro expansion runs for the 8 wire-gated types (monster say/yell/emote/whisper, BG_SYSTEM_*, RAID_BOSS_EMOTE) - '$n has taken the flag!' style lines stay literal
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: ChatPackets retains target_guid; the runtime defers unknown subjects, expands the exact eight wire-gated types through QuestTextMacroLaw.ExpandChecked, and drops known-unexpandable lines.

openItems.text: SMSG_CHAT_PLAYER_NOT_FOUND: no handler (bad whisper target is silent)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: strict cstring decoder, dispatcher handler and exact ERR_CHAT_PLAYER_NOT_FOUND_S line added.
2026-08-21: empty-body handler now emits the exact wrong-faction whisper feedback.
2026-08-21: /played sends the empty CMSG, strictly parses the two-u32 response and prints the reference total/level breakdown.

openItems.text: MSG_RANDOM_ROLL: absent (both request and broadcast shapes)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: /random aliases and 1-N/min-max grammar send the two-u32 request; the strict four-field broadcast decoder prints the reference result line.

openItems.text: CMSG_TEXT_EMOTE: no sender; SMSG_TEXT_EMOTE is opcode-table-only with no handler
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: EmoteCommandLaw aliases send the full 16-byte CMSG_TEXT_EMOTE and SMSG_TEXT_EMOTE composes the perspective/gender sentence.

2026-08-22: the authoritative local ignore list now suppresses incoming SMSG_MESSAGECHAT before any name/macro/UI side effect; ignored ordinary whispers send opcode 0x0225 with the sender's raw eight-byte GUID, while LANG_ADDON traffic remains silent. Focused clinical and production builds pass.

openItems.text: Focused suppression, opcode and golden-body checks pass. Needs an owner-run two-client session to confirm an ignored whisper stays absent locally and the sender receives the red '<name> is ignoring you.' server response; also confirm ignored say/yell traffic is silent without an outbound response.
